errors.fix: Make sure the target service is running and listening on the expected host/port
Check your network connection, firewall rules, and that the host is reachable
Check the hostname for typos and verify your DNS settings
Renew or fix the certificate, or check your system clock is correct
Check your network interface and routing configuration

errors.message: The port is already in use by another process
errors.fix: Stop the process using that port, or run this one on a different port

strings: unable to verify the first certificate
errors.fix: Install the missing CA certificate, or check you're not behind a proxy intercepting TLS

errors.message: The request followed too many redirects and gave up
errors.fix: Check for a redirect loop, or that cookies/auth needed to break out of it are being sent
